8b585b85cca9001001ffd484842db64809d78025.summary: Okta's Threat Intelligence team says the vishing cluster it tracks as O-UNC-053, previously assessed as affiliated with ShinyHunters, may have rebranded. Its data appeared on a new leak site called INCEPTION from November 16, 2026. The cluster uses voice phishing and a phishing kit to capture credentials and MFA approvals across many sectors. Unit 42 reported more than 70 legal-themed lookalike domains since October 2026. INCEPTION denies any ShinyHunters link. Whether the INCEPTION data is authentic, and the nature of any link to ShinyHunters, remain unclear.

8b7379363ff30208137df63589f03fe755886953.summary: Interpres Security report on abuse of the macOS TCC (Transparency, Consent and Control) database to bypass privacy controls. It covers DPRK-linked Lazarus Group activity and APT37's CloudMensis, plus Callisto, Bundlore, BlueBlood, JokerSpy and XCSSET samples found through VirusTotal hunting. It also covers historical CVEs (CVE-2020-9934, CVE-2020-27937, CVE-2020-9771), social engineering, and defender recommendations.
